title: Keeping the Cold
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short stories)

paragraphs.text: " Keeping the Cold " is a short story by Jeff Grubb . It was originally published in the Coldsnap Player's Guide in 2006 .

The story features Heidar , the mad Master of Rimewind at the time of The Thaw on Dominaria . He tells the story of his life to the head of his beloved Lindra , whom he has recently killed in an act of rage.
